cards.ex: We can reduce our carbon footprint by using public transport more often.
cards.exUz: Biz jamoat transportidan ko'proq foydalanib, uglerod izimizni kamaytirishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror faoliyatning atrof-muhitga ta'siri, karbonat angidrid miqdori bilan o'lchanadi.

cards.ex: Global warming is a serious threat to our planet's future.
cards.exUz: Global isish sayyoramiz kelajagi uchun jiddiy xavfdir.
cards.uzDef: Yer yuzasining o'rtacha haroratining asta-sekin ko'tarilishi, iqlim o'zgarishiga olib keladi.

cards.ex: Don't just throw away that bottle; recycle it!
cards.exUz: Bu butilkani tashlab yuborma, uni qayta ishlatishga topshir!
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz narsani axlatga tashlash, utilizatsiya qilish.

cards.ex: We need to find alternatives to fossil fuels to protect the environment.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhitni himoya qilish uchun qazilma yoqilg'iga muqobil topishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ko'mir, neft, gaz kabi yer ostidan qazib olinadigan yoqilg'ilar.

cards.ex: Investing in renewable energy is crucial for a sustainable future.
cards.exUz: Tiklanuvchi energiyaga sarmoya kiritish barqaror kelajak uchun muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Quyosh, shamol, suv kabi tugamaydigan energiya manbalari.

cards.ex: They're planning to cut down the forest to build a new shopping mall.
cards.exUz: Ular yangi savdo markazini qurish uchun o'rmonni kesib tashlamoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Daraxtlarni kesish, yo'q qilish.

cards.ex: The greenhouse effect is largely caused by the burning of fossil fuels.
cards.exUz: Issiqxona effektiga asosan qazilma yoqilg'i yoqilishi sabab bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Atmosferadagi gazlar tufayli Yer yuzasining harorati ko'tarilishi.

cards.ex: Climate change is causing more frequent and severe weather events.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi ob-havoning tez-tez va og'ir hodisalariga sabab bo'lmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq muddatli harorat va ob-havo namunalarining o'zgarishi.

cards.ex: Air pollution is a major health problem in many cities.
cards.exUz: Havoning ifloslanishi ko'plab shaharlarda asosiy sog'liq muammosidir.
cards.uzDef: Havoga zararli moddalar, tutun va gazlarning tarqalishi.

cards.ex: Water pollution can harm aquatic life and make water unsafe to drink.
cards.exUz: Suvning ifloslanishi suv hayotiga zarar etkazishi va suvni ichish uchun xavfli qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Suvga zararli moddalar, chiqindilarning tushishi.

cards.ex: Improper disposal of toxic waste can contaminate soil and water.
cards.exUz: Zaharli chiqindilarni noto'g'ri utilizatsiya qilish tuproq va suvni ifloslantirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar va atrof-muhit uchun xavfli bo'lgan chiqindilar.

cards.ex: We should all recycle paper, plastic, and glass.
cards.exUz: Biz hammamiz qog'oz, plastmassa va shishani qayta ishlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Chiqindilarni yangi mahsulotlar yaratish uchun qayta ishlatish.

cards.ex: We need to sort out the recycling before we take it to the center.
cards.exUz: Markazga olib borishdan oldin qayta ishlanadigan narsalarni saralab ajratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Narsalarni turli toifalarga ajratish.

cards.ex: The oil spill caused significant environmental damage to the coastline.
cards.exUz: Neft to'kilishi qirg'oq chizig'iga katta ekologik zarar etkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitga etkazilgan zarar, buzilish.

cards.ex: Many endangered species are threatened by habitat loss.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina yo'qolib borayotgan turlarga yashash joyining yo'qolishi tahdid solmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfi ostida turgan hayvonlar va o'simliklar.

cards.ex: Wildlife conservation is essential for maintaining biodiversity.
cards.exUz: Yovvoyi tabiatni muhofaza qilish biologik xilma-xillikni saqlash uchun zarurdir.
cards.uzDef: Yovvoyi hayvonlar va o'simliklarni himoya qilish va saqlash.

cards.ex: More and more people are trying to go green and reduce their impact on the planet.
cards.exUz: Ko'proq odamlar ekologik bo'lishga va sayyoraga ta'sirini kamaytirishga harakat qilmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitga zarar keltirmaydigan hayot tarzini olib borish.

cards.ex: The ozone layer protects us from harmful UV radiation.
cards.exUz: Ozon qatlami bizni zararli ultrabinafsha nurlanishdan himoya qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Yer atmosferasida quyoshning zararli ultrabinafsha nurlaridan himoya qiluvchi qatlam.

cards.ex: Acid rain can damage forests and lakes.
cards.exUz: Kislotali yomg'ir o'rmonlar va ko'llarga zarar etkazishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Sanoat chiqindilari va ifloslantiruvchi moddalar bilan ifloslangan yomg'ir.

cards.ex: Deforestation contributes to climate change and habitat loss.
cards.exUz: O'rmonlarning kesilishi iqlim o'zgarishiga va yashash joyining yo'qolishiga hissa qo'shadi.
cards.uzDef: Daraxtlarni kesish natijasida o'rmonlarning yo'q bo'lib ketishi.

cards.ex: Landfill sites can release harmful gases into the atmosphere.
cards.exUz: Axlat poligonlari atmosferaga zararli gazlar chiqarishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Axlat va chiqindilar ko'miladigan joy.

cards.ex: Sustainable development aims to balance economic growth with environmental protection.
cards.exUz: Barqaror rivojlanish iqtisodiy o'sishni atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish bilan muvozanatlashni maqsad qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajak avlodlar ehtiyojlarini qondirish imkoniyatini cheklamagan holda hozirgi ehtiyojlarni qondirish.

cards.ex: We should choose eco-friendly products whenever possible.
cards.exUz: Iloji boricha ekologik toza mahsulotlarni tanlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitga zarar keltirmaydigan.

cards.ex: We need to use natural resources more responsibly.
cards.exUz: Tabiiy resurslardan yanada mas'uliyatli foydalanishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yerda mavjud bo'lgan va odamlar tomonidan ishlatiladigan narsalar, masalan, suv, o'rmon, mineral.

cards.ex: Many coastal communities are at risk from rising sea levels.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina sohilbo'yi jamoalari dengiz sathining ko'tarilishidan xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Xavf-xatar ehtimoli yuqori bo'lgan holat.

cards.ex: Volunteers helped to clean up the beach after the storm.
cards.exUz: Ko'ngillilar bo'ron keyin sohilni tozalashga yordam berishdi.
cards.uzDef: Ifloslikdan tozalash, tartibga keltirish.

cards.ex: Many species are dying out because of habitat destruction.
cards.exUz: Yashash joyining yo'q qilinishi tufayli ko'plab turlar yo'q bo'lib ketmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay yo'q bo'lib ketmoq, qolmaslik.

cards.ex: We need to get rid of plastic waste.
cards.exUz: Plastik chiqindilardan qutilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz narsadan xalos bo'lish.

cards.ex: Environmental awareness is growing, and more people are taking action.
cards.exUz: Ekologik xabardorlik ortib bormoqda va ko'proq odamlar chora ko'rmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhit muammolarini tushunish va ular haqida xabardor bo'lish.

cards.ex: We're going to run out of natural resources if we don't change our habits.
cards.exUz: Agar odatlarimizni o'zgartirmasak, tabiiy resurslarimiz tugab qoladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning zaxirasi tugab qolishi.
